thesis: A representative requires explicit authority, durable interests, honesty and an inspectable record.
role: Specify the intent model and private/external semantic boundary.

ideas.statement: Representation optimizes long-term interests, with revocable narrow powers and permission to reject misleading or unsuitable matches.
A versioned intent model includes offered value, constraints, evidence, disclosure, authority, expiry, risk and closure, with ambiguity exposed for review.
Private vulnerabilities must become external criteria rather than disclosures; enforceable purpose/recipient/expiry policies and rehearsals prevent leakage.
